QUOTE: Set `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` in the project's config header ... The index's `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` config default reads "off" ... not as verified from the shipped config.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY as the build-time selector. It never says the macro is commented out in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, and it explicitly says it did not verify the shipped config.
